screen.rationale: Primary study; PS and PE microplastics with CuMgAlTi-R400 under a 50 W Xe lamp (320-780 nm, passes E3), but the only quantitative outcomes are optical particle-size reduction (Tables 1-3; 54.2% PS at 300 h, 33.7% PE at 200 h) and carbonyl-index fold changes; GC-MS intermediates (Tables 4-5) are listed by identity only, with no yields or amounts, and no molar mass is measured.

excluded_observations.what: Particle size vs time for PS and PE (Tables 1-2) and % size reduction (Table 3)
excluded_observations.why: Particle size is not an E5 endpoint.

excluded_observations.loc: 3. Results > 3.3. Photocatalytic Degradation Tests > 3.3.2. FTIR Spectroscopic Analysis ¶5

excluded_observations.what: GC-MS intermediates for PS and PE
excluded_observations.why: Identified compounds listed without yield or amount.
